== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍技師</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘指揮所に配備されている場合、「アタック・ラン」の合計値に＋1（<u>累積可能</u>）。2：自分の支配フェイズに、この技師をユーズドデッキに送る。リザーブデッキから、「デス・スター：トレンチ」を探して手札に入れる。その後でリザーブデッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">デル・ゴーレンは通信とスキャナー妨害の専門家で、同盟軍の高等司令部に所属する以前は、反乱軍の民間型武装コルベット船、スパイラルの乗組員であった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Tech]].

'''Lore''' — Del Goren is an expert in communications and scanner jamming. Before he belonged to Alliance High Command, he was a crewman on the Rebel privateer corvette Spiral.

'''Game text''' — Choose one.
1: If deployed at a war room, add 1 to the Attack Run total (cumulative).
2: During your control phase, send this technician to the Used Pile. Search the Reserve Deck for Death Star: Trench and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese numbers two choose-one options. The war-room condition is only on option 1. English puts both functions under “When at one of your war rooms.”<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-rebeltech-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Tech]].</ref>
